---
title: "DVT Dataset Prep"
format: html
---

This workflow prepares an export of the data modified for display on the [FCRWQDC Data Visualization Tool](https://github.com/USF-IMARS/FCRWQDC_data_dashboard).

```{R, load and prep file}
df <- read.csv(here::here("data", "Unified_WQ_Database(2023 updated).csv"))

# prepare datetime col from Y M D & drop old cols
df$datetime <- as.Date(paste(df$Year, df$Month, df$Day, sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")
df$Year <- NULL
df$Month <- NULL
df$Day <- NULL

# drop other unnecessary cols
df$Total.Depth <- NULL

# create data/exports if DNE
dir.create(here::here("data", "exports"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# save to csv
write.csv(df, here::here("data", "exports", "dashboardDataSEACAR.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
